item.summary: The 14th Meeting of the India-Thailand Joint Trade Committee (JTC) was held on 16 November 2026 at the Ministry of Commerce, Nonthaburi, Thailand. The meeting was co-chaired by Additional Secretary, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Shri Nitin Kumar Yadav, and Director-General, Department of Trade Negotiations, Ministry of Commerce, Thailand, Ms. Chotima Iemsawasdikul.…
item.title: India and Thailand Review Bilateral Trade and Economic Cooperation at 14th Joint Trade Committee Meeting in Nonthaburi, Thailand
